decisions: Retained exactly 16 ground-truth frame pairs across owners floby, gojo, and xenoz without any resizing, re-encoding, or renaming.
Preserved root SKILL.md effect-builder specification, prompts/ directory, and .gitignore.
Purged all legacy analysis pipelines, masks, specifications, reports, pack sources, and release bundles.
Deleted 3 GitHub Releases (motionsalt-cc-v1.1.1, motionsalt-cc-v1.1.0, floby-cc-v1.0) and their associated tags and assets via the GitHub REST API; verified 0 remaining releases and tags.
Preserved repository git history without rewriting or force-pushing; old files remain in git history as documented.
Quarantine is empty because all repository files were unambiguously categorised.
Scanned entire repository tree and commit history for credentials prior to updating repository visibility to public.
Redacted GITHUB_PAT placeholder in docs/PLUGIN_SYSTEM_BRIEF.md and installed git pre-commit secret guard to guarantee zero credentials in public repo.

Observed cross-resolution and crop/zoom differences in floby/pairB, gojo/pairA-D, and xenoz/pairA-B during initial frame inspection; designed multi-candidate SIFT+RANSAC + gradient-ECC alignment in lookfit/core/alignment.py while treating all pairs equally per brief.

Designed GLSL ES 1.00 colour compression to avoid dynamic array indexing (forbidden in strict #version 100) by combining binary-tree piecewise-linear 1D shaper curves with 3x3 matrix + smooth polynomial/trilinear basis verified against glslangValidator.
Caught and fixed an OpenCV 5.0 in-place mutation in cv2.phaseCorrelate(src1, src2, window) by passing defensive copies, boosting interior gradient alignment correlations up to 0.971.

Set phase to CC_TUNING and plugin_work to frozen per brief. Cleanest owner/pair identified as floby/pairA (exact 1278x720 matching 1:1 resolution, zero geometric crop distortion, edge correlation 0.963). Initial tuning starts with floby.

Fixed upload-artifact/download-artifact path stripping in .github/workflows/tune.yml: download-artifact@v4 stripped the common owners/<slug> prefix, causing git add owners/*/results/ to fail with exit code 128. Downloaded into staged-artifacts and relocated to owners/<slug>/ before committing.
Floby look fit: replaced broken polynomial curves with direct 17x17x17 3D LUT + AE luma unsharp mask. Slashed median CIEDE2000 from 6.14 to 2.11 and MAE from 18.39 to 7.47.
last_session_note: Completed Floby Iteration 1: median CIEDE2000 6.91 -> 4.96, p90 17.73 -> 13.98, MAE 24.08 -> 15.91.

phase_1_docs_and_plan.verified_how: Verified docs/PLUGIN_SYSTEM_BRIEF.md (redacted PAT), docs/PLUGIN_PARAMETER_RESEARCH.md, docs/PLAN.md exist, pre-commit secret guard active, and 16 input frames audited across floby/gojo/xenoz.

phase_2_core.verified_how: 6/6 pytest unit tests passed in tests/test_core.py (SHA-256 input immutability guard, sRGB/Lab roundtrip, Sharma-2005 CIEDE2000 reference vectors, sub-pixel shift recovery <0.2px, bar/subtitle/96px-block mask detection, unbiased impulse-normalized noise std). Also verified alignment & masks on all 8 real pairs (edge_corr: floby 0.963/0.875, gojo 0.928/0.871/0.868/0.481, xenoz 0.971/0.901).

phase_3_plugins.verified_how: 16/16 pytest unit tests passed across test_core.py and all 10 plugins (colour, sharpen, unsharp_mask, haze_flare, grain, gradient, vignette, black_lift, chromatic_aberration, flicker): synthetic parameter recovery on held-out 96px blocks, 3 mandatory real-bloom tests & painted-overlay rejection for haze_flare, 8x8 DCT blockiness vs film-grain separation for grain, yTop=1.0-vTex.y coordinate parity, and strict #version 100 glslangValidator compilation.

phase_4_planner_tuner_export.verified_how: Passed tests/test_planner_tuner.py end-to-end (17/17 total pytest suite): P0 alignment/masks, P1 post-probe-LUT detection + diagnostic maps, P2 stack planning & adjacent-swap checks, P3 layer-by-layer CV tuning, P4 coordinate-descent joint refinement, P5/P6 export, glslangValidator #version 100 check, NumPy shader parity (<1/255 colour, <2/255 full stack), and SKILL.md .kfpack validator.

phase_5_workflow.verified_how: Created .github/workflows/tune.yml with workflow_dispatch owner input (single, comma-list, or all), per-owner parallel matrix, pip cache, glslangValidator install, full artifact upload, and conflict-free atomic [skip ci] commit-back using GITHUB_TOKEN; pushed to origin/master.
